ann.t: Outcome of Board Meeting — DUDIGITAL GLOBAL LIMITED has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.

Acquisition — DUDIGITAL GLOBAL LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Acquisition of 51% equity share capital of DG AG Holdings Limited, Abu Dhabi, UAE by Dudigital Global LLC (wholly owned subsidiary) of the Company.
Change in Auditors — DUDIGITAL GLOBAL LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding Change in Auditors of the company.
Acquisition — DUDIGITAL GLOBAL LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Conversion of existing loan into equity shares.

Pendency of Litigation(s)/dispute(s) or the outcome impacting the Company — DUDIGITAL GLOBAL LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Pendency of Litigation(s)/dispute(s) or the outcome impacting the Company
Updates — DUDIGITAL GLOBAL LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding 'Submission of Financial Results for the period ended March 31, 2026 in readable format'.
Outcome of Board Meeting — DUDIGITAL GLOBAL LIMITED has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026.

Press Release — DUDIGITAL GLOBAL LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated April 22, 2026, titled "Dudigital Global Limited Secures CPV Services Contract from Embassy of India, Kuwait".
Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts — DUDIGITAL GLOBAL LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Declaration as L1 Bidder and Bagging/ Receiving of CPV Services Contract by Embassy of India, Kuwait.

Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations — Rajinder Rai has Submitted to the Exchange a copy of Disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
Updates — DUDIGITAL GLOBAL LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding 'Qualification in Technical Bids for CPV Service Tenders in Multiple Locations'.
Acquisition — DUDIGITAL GLOBAL LIMITED has informed the Exchange about the Execution of Share Purchase Agreement by Wholly-Owned Subsidiary.
Acquisition — DUDIGITAL GLOBAL LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Acquisition of additional shares in Virtuworld Tourism LLC (Wholly Owned Subsidiary)
Resignation — DUDIGITAL GLOBAL LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of Mr Lalit Chawla as Company Secretary & Compliance Officer of the company w.e.f. December 05, 2025.
